queue_evidence.rule: Q = max over calibration ring rank-rows of (GPU_end - host_end_r) * launches_r / wall (lower bound of the hard cap); nominal CUDA queue 1024

status.eps_sched[kind, b_prev2]: measured (host_start_0(i) - GPU_end(i-2) after a decode iteration; per b table, MIN_N rule)
status.a_host: measured (host_start_r(i) - host_end_r(i-1) after mixed iterations, per rank)
status.f_idle: measured (first kernel - host start when the GPU was idle; n=4)
status.delta_launch: inferred (individual launch -> GPU start latency, 20 us; not separately identifiable, second order)
status.h_pre / p_post: measured (forward start - host start; host end - forward end; per kind and rank)
status.hostwin_dec / n_launch_dec: measured per b (decode host forward window, launches)
status.queue_depth: measured lower bound (max implied depth on calibration ring rows)
status.segment profile: measured (median normalized compute window per rank and segment, quantiles for stochastic draws)
status.launch distribution over segments: assumed uniform (launch index proportional to segment index); not identifiable per segment from the API trace
status.rank-2 host lateness: not identifiable (gap G4): carried as the measured per-rank c_host of Phase 1A, no cause modelled
status.c_kv (KV-dependent launch cost): not identifiable: Phase 1A value 0 kept; launch count still grows with KV16 (measured)
status.dispersion: measured (calibration quantiles of wall / reference; used only to widen the stochastic band, mean-1 factor)
status.mixed segment jitter: not sampled: per-segment jitter is common-mode across ranks; independent sampling over-predicted ring walls by 6 %
